mapper.sql: SELECT final_selection.final_selection_id, strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_option.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.case_code, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, final_selection.created_at AS established_at, final_selection.last_synced_at, sku.sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, sku.unit_code, product.product_name, product.image_url, strategy_option.option_name, strategy_option.recommendation_reason, execution_result.result_status, execution_result.planned_start_date, execution_result.planned_end_date, execution_result.goal_target_value, execution_result.goal_actual_value, execution_result.achievement_rate FROM ( SELECT selection.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY selection.strategy_case_id ORDER BY selection.created_at DESC, selection.final_selection_id DESC ) AS selection_rank FROM final_strategy_selection selection WHERE selection.is_deleted = 0 ) final_selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = final_selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_option ON strategy_option.strategy_option_id = final_selection.strategy_option_id AND strategy_option.strategy_case_id = strategy_case.strategy_case_id AND strategy_option.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id AND sku.is_deleted = 0 JOIN product ON product.product_id = sku.product_id AND product.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT latest_result.* FROM ( SELECT result.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY result.final_selection_id ORDER BY result.strategy_execution_result_id DESC ) AS result_rank FROM strategy_execution_result result WHERE result.is_deleted = 0 ) latest_result WHERE latest_result.result_rank = 1 ) execution_result ON execution_result.final_selection_id = final_selection.final_selection_id WHERE final_selection.selection_rank = 1

sql.if: AND ( UPPER(strategy_case.case_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{query.query}) || '%' OR UPPER(product.product_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{query.query}) || '%' OR UPPER(sku.sku_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{query.query}) || '%' )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM strategy_action filtered_action WHERE filtered_action.strategy_option_id = strategy_option.strategy_option_id AND filtered_action.action_type = #{query.actionType} AND filtered_action.is_deleted = 0 )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN filtered_executions.case_status != 'READY_TO_EXECUTE' THEN filtered_executions.strategy_case_id END) AS execution_strategy_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN filtered_executions.case_status = 'EXECUTING' THEN filtered_executions.strategy_case_id END) AS in_progress_strategy_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN filtered_executions.result_status = 'PARTIAL' THEN filtered_executions.strategy_case_id END) AS attention_strategy_count, COUNT(DISTINCT filtered_executions.strategy_case_id) AS total_strategy_count FROM (
) filtered_executions

ORDER BY
final_selection.created_at ASC, final_selection.final_selection_id ASC
final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC
OFFSET #{query.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{query.size} ROWS ONLY
AND strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH selected_strategy AS ( SELECT selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.sku_id FROM final_strategy_selection selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 WHERE selection.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND selection.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY selection.created_at DESC, selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), location_source AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN snapshot.sales_point_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SALES_POINT' ELSE 'WAREHOUSE' END AS location_type, COALESCE(snapshot.sales_point_id, snapshot.warehouse_id) AS location_id, COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_code, warehouse.warehouse_code) AS location_code, COALESCE(sales_point.sales_point_name, warehouse.warehouse_name) AS location_name, snapshot.on_hand_qty AS before_quantity, snapshot.safety_stock_qty AS safety_stock_quantity FROM strategy_inventory_snapshot snapshot LEFT JOIN sales_point ON sales_point.sales_point_id = snapshot.sales_point_id AND sales_point.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN warehouse ON warehouse.warehouse_id = snapshot.warehouse_id AND warehouse.is_deleted = 0 WHERE snapshot.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND snapshot.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SALES_POINT', point.sales_point_id, point.sales_point_code, point.sales_point_name, 0, NULL FROM selected_strategy selected JOIN strategy_action action ON action.strategy_option_id = selected.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sales_point point ON point.sales_point_id IN (action.source_sales_point_id, action.target_sales_point_id) AND point.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WAREHOUSE', warehouse.warehouse_id, warehouse.warehouse_code, warehouse.warehouse_name, 0, NULL FROM selected_strategy selected JOIN strategy_action action ON action.strategy_option_id = selected.strategy_option_id AND action.is_deleted = 0 JOIN warehouse ON warehouse.warehouse_id IN (action.source_warehouse_id, action.destination_warehouse_id) AND warehouse.is_deleted = 0 ), location_scope AS ( SELECT location_type, location_id, MAX(location_code) AS location_code, MAX(location_name) AS location_name, SUM(before_quantity) AS before_quantity, SUM(safety_stock_quantity) AS safety_stock_quantity FROM location_source WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location_type, location_id ) SELECT scope.location_type, scope.location_id, scope.location_code, scope.location_name, scope.before_quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(balance.inventory_balance_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(balance.on_hand_qty) END AS current_quantity, scope.safety_stock_quantity FROM location_scope scope CROSS JOIN selected_strategy selected LEFT JOIN inventory_balance balance ON balance.sku_id = selected.sku_id AND balance.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (scope.location_type = 'WAREHOUSE' AND balance.warehouse_id = scope.location_id) OR ( scope.location_type = 'SALES_POINT' AND scope.location_id IN (balance.stock_sales_point_id, balance.allocated_sales_point_id) ) ) GROUP BY scope.location_type, scope.location_id, scope.location_code, scope.location_name, scope.before_quantity, scope.safety_stock_quantity ORDER BY scope.location_type, scope.location_name

WITH selected_strategy AS ( SELECT final_selection.strategy_option_id, strategy_case.sku_id, execution_result.planned_start_date, execution_result.planned_end_date FROM final_strategy_selection final_selection JOIN strategy_case ON strategy_case.strategy_case_id = final_selection.strategy_case_id AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0 JOIN strategy_execution_result execution_result ON execution_result.final_selection_id = final_selection.final_selection_id AND execution_result.is_deleted = 0 WHERE final_selection.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND final_selection.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY final_selection.created_at DESC, final_selection.final_selection_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ), relevant_points AS ( SELECT action.source_sales_point_id AS sales_point_id FROM strategy_action action JOIN selected_strategy selected ON selected.strategy_option_id = action.strategy_option_id WHERE action.is_deleted = 0 AND action.source_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT action.target_sales_point_id FROM strategy_action action JOIN selected_strategy selected ON selected.strategy_option_id = action.strategy_option_id WHERE action.is_deleted = 0 AND action.target_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT sales.sales_date, sales.sales_point_id, sales_point.sales_point_code, sales_point.sales_point_name, sales.net_sales_qty AS quantity, sales.net_sales_amount AS revenue FROM selected_strategy selected JOIN sales_daily sales ON sales.sku_id = selected.sku_id AND sales.sales_date >= selected.planned_start_date AND sales.sales_date <= selected.planned_end_date AND sales.sales_date <= #{asOfDate} AND sales.is_deleted = 0 JOIN relevant_points relevant ON relevant.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id JOIN sales_point ON sales_point.sales_point_id = sales.sales_point_id AND sales_point.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sales.sales_date, sales.sales_point_id

SELECT aggregated.performance_count, aggregated.actual_sales_quantity, aggregated.actual_revenue, aggregated.actual_contribution_margin, ( SELECT latest.actual_remaining_qty FROM strategy_performance latest WHERE latest.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND latest.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY latest.performance_date DESC, latest.strategy_performance_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS actual_remaining_quantity FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS performance_count, SUM(performance.actual_sales_qty) AS actual_sales_quantity, SUM(performance.actual_revenue) AS actual_revenue, SUM(performance.actual_contribution_margin) AS actual_contribution_margin FROM strategy_performance performance WHERE performance.strategy_option_id = #{strategyOptionId} AND performance.is_deleted = 0 ) aggregated
